title: Battle Royale
description: Game mode in which players compete within an ever-shrinking area, gathering resources and eliminating one another until only one remains standing.
body:
# Battle Royale

Ultra light datapack that allows you to set up a multiplayer _Battle Royale / Purge / Hunger Games / Fortnite Style_ on your server/lan with one command.

There are three stages of the event:

1. **Peace**: Collect resources, PVP is disabled.
2. **War**: PVP is enabled.
3. **Shrink**: Border shrinks down to spawn and forces all players to fight it out.


## Set up
1. Put this datapack in the datapacks folder of your server world. (**Recommend using a world you don't mind trashing**)
2. Teleport to a random unexplored area.
3. Run the command:
```
/function minipurge:start { lives:<value>, border:<value>, peace:<value>, war:<value>, shrink:<value> }
```
_**(!) This command will teleport all players and clear their inventories!**_

_Where each <value> can be set to your liking! This allows for:_
> **"lives"** is the number of lives a player has before going into spectator. 
> 
> **"border"** is the size of the starting border.
> 
> **"peace"** is the length of no pvp in minutes.
> 
> **"war"** is the length of enabled pvp in minutes.
> 
> **"shrink"** is the amount of time it takes for the border to shrink to 10 blocks in minutes.

### Other useful commands:

```
/function minipurge:reset
```
```
/function minipurge:pause
```
```
/function minipurge:unpause
```

Pause and unpause will only work if _function-permission-level = 4 or higher_.
